title: CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Terms of Renewal, Lapse, Reinstatement and Cancellation
content:
## Renewal

Where the tier renews automatically, the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan renews for another plan year on the day after the plan year end unless cancelled; the renewed plan fee may rise by at most the tier's renewal price increase cap percent. A tier change takes effect only at renewal.

## Lapse and reinstatement

A plan that does not renew lapses, closing on the day after the plan year end. A lapsed plan may be reinstated, at the customer's request, for a new plan year starting on the reinstatement date, with no rollover.

## Cancellation

1. Cancelling the plan is the customer's own act by written notice.
2. A cancellation takes effect no earlier than the tier's cancellation notice in calendar days after the date the written cancellation notice is received.
3. Count calendar days starting the day after the notice is received; the cancellation takes effect on the last day of the notice period or a later date the notice names.
4. On cancellation remaining units expire, and the tier's refund percent of the unused share of a prepaid plan fee (by whole months remaining in the plan year) is refunded by credit memo.

The clock starts from the date the written notice is received, as recorded on the plan.

| Tier | Notice period (calendar days) | Refund of the unused share of a prepaid plan fee (percent) |
|---|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | 30 | 0 |
| CalCare Basic Plan | 30 | 0 |
| CalCare Standard Plan | 30 | 0 |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 60 | 50 |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | 60 | 50 |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | 90 | 50 |

## Notice period at its boundary (hypothetical notice of 30 calendar days, received 1 March)

Day 1 is 2 March and day 30, the last day of the notice period, is 31 March.

| Date named in the notice | Cancellation takes effect |
|---|---|
| none | 31 March |
| 31 March | 31 March |
| 15 April | 15 April |
| 20 March | 31 March; an earlier date is not possible |

A cancellation taking effect on 31 March meets the notice period; one on 30 March would not.

## Refund in figures (hypothetical)

A prepaid plan fee of 1200.00 for a 12-month plan year, 6 whole months remaining in the plan year, refund percent 50: the unused share is 6 of 12 months, that is 600.00, and 50 percent of it, 300.00, is refunded by credit memo.

## Renewal cap in figures (hypothetical)

A plan fee of 1000.00 with a renewal price increase cap of 5 percent renews at no more than 1050.00.
